title: What Each Automated Check Can and Cannot Find
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Four automated tools, each split into what it finds and what it cannot find, with a reminder to keep a human in the loop.

educational.topic: What automated checks find and what they miss
learningObjectives: The learner will state what each of four automated checks can find and what it cannot, and explain why a clean scan is not a finished review.
prerequisites: Automated checks and the human in the loop from [Chapter 13](../../chapters/13-automated-checks-cost-privacy/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: What did this tool actually look at?
What would a person still need to check?
commonMisconceptions: A clean scan means the resource is accessible
Automated checks replace the human reviewer
assessmentOpportunities: A link checker reports no broken links. What can it not tell you?
Can an accessibility scan tell you whether alt text is useful?
What can a readability scan not find?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
